quotes: rival named but not built (test_rival = NAME ONLY, rivals_built empty): "A version that opens in medias res with F and H, then flashes back, cutting A–D and the model demonstration entirely, could plausibly do the 'reader accepts the premise' job just as well (many later time-travel stories work this way).
